bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; providing that certain felons are ineligible to serve as jurors in criminal cases; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 593.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[593.55] FELONS INELIGIBLE FOR JURY SERVICE WHILE UNDER SUPERVISION. +]

[+Notwithstanding any law or court rule to the contrary, a person who is under correctional supervision for a felony offense is not eligible to serve on a jury, including a grand jury, in a criminal case. This prohibition applies until the person's sentence has been discharged as provided in section 609.165. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; providing that certain felons are ineligible to serve as jurors in criminal cases; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 593.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[593.55] FELONS INELIGIBLE FOR JURY SERVICE WHILE UNDER SUPERVISION.

Notwithstanding any law or court rule to the contrary, a person who is under correctional supervision for a felony offense is not eligible to serve on a jury, including a grand jury, in a criminal case. This prohibition applies until the person's sentence has been discharged as provided in section 609.165.
